# The Open Witness Archive

Original-fiction archive about Ivo Ren / Sovereign. Read complete, publicly accessible HTML pages. Distinguish the chosen Open Witness practice from the Unruled Witness peak state. Canon events, in-universe theory, peak-form design, and comparative analysis are marked within the text.
